diagnosis: Progress has stalled at $-3.7\times10^{-7}$ below the record because every successful program starts from `record.npy`/`best.npy` and its LogSumExp plus trust-region LP polish reconverges to the same basin. The image shows roughly 740 pairs tied within $10^{-9}$ of the maximum, so the configuration is hyper-jammed with zero rattlers and no infinitesimal tangent move can lower the maximum. Yet contact degrees are wildly irregular, from about 1--2 to 23 contacts per point, whereas a point on $S^7$ needs at least 7 well-spread contacts to be locally locked, so the graph lacks the balanced, positively stressed, near-regular contact structure expected of a genuinely better optimum. Single-point hole filling therefore cannot work: improvement requires a coordinated rearrangement that transfers contacts from overloaded points to under-locked points and changes the contact topology.
